fr_html: M. LODER déclare au contraire que le discours de Mr. Root ne l'a pas converti, mais, se sentant seul, il s'abstient pourtant de présenter un amendement.
en_html: M. LODER, on the contrary, said that Mr. Root's speech had not converted him, but as he felt that he stood alone, he would refrain from putting forward an amendment.
